system.omamori: Give this Talisman to another creature, until your next rest you can as an action see through their eyes instead of your own.
system.ofuda: Look into a reflection or clear pool of water. As an action you may select a location you are generally aware of within a 1000 yards * Arcane Might and cause it to appear in the reflection. If you have a Connection to your target and are a Miasma Miko you can also view the location of your target regardless of the distance and become aware of their general location and direction.
